## Result

Lead Hub launched on 2026-09-15 and the LeadLab Director accepted the application. The recorded launch and completed actions support a closure decision, but they do not prove that every operational control is complete. The safe closure option is a conditional administrative closure only if the PM accepts the remaining controls as active operations follow-on work and accepts the current ownership gaps. Otherwise, the project should remain open until the handoff evidence is complete.

## Proposed Lessons

These are proposed observations for PM review. They are not entries in the canonical lessons register yet.

| Candidate lesson | Evidence basis | Possible recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| Feature completion and operational readiness must remain separate control questions | Local implementation records repeatedly retain target-environment, mail, queue, scheduler, monitoring, backup, and ownership gaps | Keep operational evidence and feature acceptance as separate gates in future delivery plans |
| Confirmed provider selection does not by itself prove an operable delivery service | Postmark is selected and email verification is confirmed, while queue, scheduler, monitoring, severity, and ownership remain separate | Record provider, worker, scheduler, monitoring, and escalation decisions as one linked operations package |
| Closure records must be tied to the current platform and launch, not reused from a prior solution | The available closure report describes the older SharePoint portal, while Lead Hub is the current application | Create a current closure carrier for each materially different platform or phase |

## Recommendation

Prepare the current closure carrier and retain the residual controls as active operations follow-on work only if the PM confirms that this is the intended business closure boundary. Do not mark the project, PM-09, the residual controls, or the proposed lessons complete by inference.
